message: The assembly '{0}' is required by the compile-time code of a referenced assembly, but it cannot be found among the references of the current project. Add a reference to '{0}'.
rationale: The current message does not say why the assembly is required or where Metalama looked for it, and gives no way forward. CompileTimeProjectRepository.Builder.TryGetCompileTimeProject reports it when an assembly listed in the compile-time manifest of a referenced assembly is not among the references of the current compilation.
codeChange: The diagnostic is reported with Location.None and does not name the referenced assembly whose compile-time code requires '{0}'. Passing the identity of that assembly (runTimeAssemblyIdentity in TryDeserializeCompileTimeProject) as a second argument would let the message name it.
